vulnerability_analysis: The NowMeta contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxAmount that can set the maximum transaction amount to any value, including 0. Setting it to 0 would prevent all token transfers since the _transfer function requires amount <= maxTxAmount. This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can freeze the entire token economy.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxAmount(0) to demonstrate the owner can abuse their privilege to freeze all transfers.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Create an interface for the NowMeta contract with the owner() and setMaxTxAmount() functions. 2. Get the current owner address. 3. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 4. Call setMaxTxAmount(0). 5. Verify that maxTxAmount is now 0.
